PHASE_1_FINDING.question_as_posed: at identical initial microstate, replace the Route E dynamics by the frozen positive dynamics of NONMERGING_CONFIRM_02
PHASE_1_FINDING.reason: the two are not two laws of one substrate; they are TWO DIFFERENT SUBSTRATES with disjoint state spaces. No initial microstate is shared, so the requested paired swap has no domain.

route_e.geometry: periodic L x L, L in {16,24,32}
route_e.cohort: enrolled union of all detected components, passive tracer

nonmerging_confirm_02.state: SCState(rho, U, V, c, N, C, uptake, step)
nonmerging_confirm_02.extra_dynamics: reaction-diffusion with an internal toggle network (a=2.0, K=0.5, D_int=0.008, tau=0.20, beta=0.6) and exact cohorts sum_c C == rho
nonmerging_confirm_02.readout: uptake, coupled to m_plus by construction

PHASE_1_FINDING.consequence: The effect must NOT be attributed to a law. It cannot even be attributed to a DYNAMICS_PACKAGE within one substrate, because the substrates differ.

EXECUTABLE_SUBSTITUTE.rationale: The scientific content of the question that IS testable: does the SWEEP_00 failure (no persistent bounded non-wrapping component) belong to the one law used there, or is it generic over the frozen Route E law measure? This holds the substrate AND the initial microstate bit-identical and varies only the LawSpec.
EXECUTABLE_SUBSTITUTE.design: paired, same seed -> bit-identical initial microstate across all law arms

arms.name: BASELINE_SWEEP00
arms.law: LatticeBondSpec(dt=1.0, m_max=1.0, n_max=1.0) with frozen defaults

EXECUTABLE_SUBSTITUTE.law_source: propose_law_fields(seed_root, index) from future_route_e_pre_run_frame.py, the FROZEN law measure; every arm passed in_proposal_box() AND engine_accepts()
EXECUTABLE_SUBSTITUTE.initial_condition: the frozen production IC m ~ U(0,1), n = 0.8, b = 0 -- identical bytes for a given (seed, L) across every arm

seeds: DEV_CAUSAL_BRIDGE_00 namespace 910000-910011, offset by size; open, recorded before the run, PERMANENTLY EXCLUDED from any future primary, reproduction or holdout
native_horizon_note: NONMERGING_CONFIRM_02 has a different native horizon (probe 0.25x5, horizon 40 in its own substrate units at dt=0.1); it is NOT commensurable with the lattice_bond step count and is therefore NOT added to this schedule. Recorded as a declared limitation rather than forced.

primary_paired_comparison.outcome: bounded_survival_to_1024 = (never wraps) AND (at least one component at EVERY sampled frame) AND (a non-wrapping component exists at frame 1024)
primary_paired_comparison.unit: one (seed, L) pair, matched across arms
primary_paired_comparison.test: per-arm survival counts with conservative Wilson lower bounds; paired McNemar-style discordance counts vs BASELINE_SWEEP00; no p-value is used as a decision cut
primary_paired_comparison.censoring: a world that raises inside the engine is recorded as TECHNICAL_FAILURE and kept in the denominator; it is never replaced, retried or topped up

decision_table.LAW_IS_CAUSAL_FOR_SURVIVAL: at least one drawn law shows bounded survival on both L=24 and L=32 with a Wilson lower bound above 0 while BASELINE survives 0
decision_table.LAW_NOT_CAUSAL_WITHIN_FROZEN_MEASURE: survival is 0 in every arm at both sizes
decision_table.INDETERMINATE: survival appears at one size only, or in a single seed with no size replication

measurement_controls.purpose: validate detection, wrapping and dissolution only -- NOT cohort_residual
cases: a persistent compact bounded non-wrapping component
measurement_controls.path: the production detect_components on hand-built states

declared_limitations: the requested Route E <-> NONMERGING_CONFIRM_02 swap is not executable; the substitute varies the LAW inside the Route E substrate and answers a strictly narrower question
5 laws is a sample of the frozen measure, not the measure; absence of survival across 5 laws does not establish absence across the family

the schedule is non-uniform (8 frames) rather than the pilot cadence 16 (65 frames); wrapping and dissolution are step functions in practice, so this cannot change the sign of a null, but a transient between sampled frames could be missed
no scaffold world is run as a paired counterpart; any scaffold measurement is a REFERENCE, never a causal contrast
